item.text:
Refactored the package so the circular-buffer storage is no longer embedded directly in the queue class.

I added [RingBuffer.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/043_circular_queue/src/main/java/queue/RingBuffer.java:1) as a package-private component that owns the low-level ring state: array storage, head/tail movement, wrap-around indexing, clearing, fail-fast iteration, and string rendering. [CircularQueue.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/043_circular_queue/src/main/java/queue/CircularQueue.java:6) is now a thin bounded-queue adapter over that buffer, so its responsibility is just queue semantics and null/full handling.

That’s a cleaner separation than the previous version: `AbstractBoundedQueue` handles API behavior, `CircularQueue` handles queue policy, and `RingBuffer` handles storage mechanics.

```text
make clean test run-demo
```
